name: Exp_Color3rdGenXMA
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the Color3rdGenXMA custom indicator, which uses a third-generation moving average with configurable smoothing methods. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0), with time-based entry filtering and position holding duration limits.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Color3rdGenXMA自定义指标信号进行交易，该指标使用第三代移动平均线并支持多种平滑方法。当指标值为2时开多仓，为0时开空仓，同时具有基于时间的入场过滤和持仓时长限制功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于第三代指数移动平均线（Color3rdGenXMA）的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值等于2时产生买入信号，等于0时产生卖出信号，中间值1表示无方向信号。入场时间受到严格控制，仅在用户指定的特定小时和分钟（StartHour:StartMinute）才允许开仓，这是一种时段交易过滤机制。出场条件包括：指标反向信号触发平仓（需开启BuyPosClose/SellPosClose），以及基于持仓时间的强制平仓（TimeMin参数，默认720分钟）。仓位管理通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库实现，支持五种资金管理模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、自由保证金亏损比例、余额亏损比例和固定手数。EA还支持最大价格偏差（滑点）控制和历史数据加载以确保指标计算正确性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the third-generation moving average indicator (Color3rdGenXMA). Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 equals 2, and a sell signal when it equals 0, with the value 1 representing no directional signal. Entry timing is strictly controlled, only allowing new positions at a user-specified hour and minute (StartHour:StartMinute), functioning as a session-based trade filter. Exit conditions include: indicator reversal signals triggering position closure (if BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are enabled), and forced closure based on position holding time (TimeMin parameter, default 720 minutes). Position sizing is managed through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, supporting five money management modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, free margin loss share, balance loss share, and fixed lot size. The EA also implements maximum price deviation (slippage) control and history data loading to ensure correct indicator calculations.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算方式（自由保证金/余额/亏损比例/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing method (free margin/balance/loss ratio/fixed lot)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差（滑点）点数

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing long positions on indicator signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on indicator signal

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 平滑参数（JJMA范围-100到+100，VIDYA为CMO周期，AMA为慢速均线周期）
parameters.description_en: Smoothing parameter (JJMA: -100 to +100, VIDYA: CMO period, AMA: slow MA period)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 支持10种平滑算法，策略灵活性高，可适应不同市场环境
具有时间过滤机制，避免在不合适时段入场，降低假信号风险
持仓时间限制（TimeMin）防止长期套牢，强制止盈止损管理风险
五种资金管理模式提供了灵活的仓位控制选项
允许分别控制开仓和平仓权限，策略可精细调整
pros_en: Supports 10 smoothing algorithms, providing high strategy flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Time-based entry filter avoids trading during unfavorable sessions, reducing false signal risk
Position holding time limit (TimeMin) prevents prolonged drawdowns, with forced stop-loss and take-profit for risk management
Five money management modes offer flexible position sizing control options
Separate permission controls for opening and closing positions allow fine-grained strategy tuning
cons: 入场时间过滤仅精确到分钟且仅在单一时刻触发，可能错过最佳入场时机或在非理想时刻强制入场
默认关闭指标信号平仓功能（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose=false），趋势反转时无法及时退出
未包含点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
依赖自定义指标Color3rdGenXMA，若该指标未正确安装则EA无法运行
信号仅基于单一指标，缺乏多维度确认，可能产生较多假信号
cons_en: Entry time filter is precise only to the minute and triggers at a single moment, potentially missing optimal entries or forcing entries at suboptimal times
Indicator-based position closing is disabled by default (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose=false), preventing timely exits on trend reversals
No spread filter included, which may lead to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Depends on the custom Color3rdGenXMA indicator, which must be correctly installed or the EA cannot run
Signals are based on a single indicator without multi-dimensional confirmation, potentially generating many false signals
improvements: 增加点差过滤和多时间框架确认，减少不利成交和假信号
将入场时间过滤改为时间区间而非单一时刻，提高入场灵活性
增加移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，在趋势延续时保护利润
improvements_en: Add spread filtering and multi-timeframe confirmation to reduce unfavorable fills and false signals
Change the entry time filter from a single moment to a time window for greater entry flexibility
Add a trailing stop feature to protect profits during trend continuation

risk_points: 默认关闭指标信号平仓，趋势反转时可能持续持有亏损仓位直至止损或超时
单一指标信号缺乏确认机制，震荡行情中可能频繁止损
入场时间限定在单一分钟，若该时刻价格跳空可能以不利价格成交
risk_points_en: Indicator-based closing disabled by default, potentially holding losing positions until stop-loss or timeout on trend reversal
Single indicator signal lacks confirmation mechanism, may trigger frequent stop-losses in ranging markets
Entry limited to a single minute, risk of unfavorable fills if price gaps at that moment

It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0), with time-based entry filtering and position holding duration limits.
